name: 泥潭二
english_description: A wuxia mudlib built on the ES2/Annihilator engine lineage, part of the broader 'Mire' (nitan/NT) family but with its own independently written attribute-storage code — it doesn't share the nt6/nt1 branch's architecture bugs. At roughly 13,000 source files, it has its own version of the 'birth ceremony' registration ritual seen in nt6, right down to matching file names, an interesting case of convergent design within the same broader engine scene despite being coded independently.
